title: A Survey on Responsible LLMs: Inherent Risk, Malicious Use, and Mitigation Strategy
findings: The paper, in its review of value-related risks, cites a study by Santurkar et al. [169] which found that LLMs can be left-leaning and underrepresent certain communities, providing 'Mormon' as a specific example.
